title: focus_spec
description: One guided focus per use case: the AI writes it at generation time, the App renders it with a fixed library. The python (server/focus_spec.py) and JS (web/src/focusSpec.js) validators read the x-rules block below, so both give the same verdict.

block_use_when.bridge: the total moved and the user needs to see which parts added or took away
block_use_when.strip: one number matters and the user needs to see where this record sits among the others
block_use_when.histogram: the user needs to see how all records spread and whether this one is unusual
block_use_when.trend_band: the value changes over time and the user needs the usual range around it
block_use_when.ranked_bars: the user needs to compare a few named parts and see which is biggest
block_use_when.small_multiples: the same measure is compared across several groups side by side
block_use_when.share_shift: the mix between parts changed and the user needs to see who gained or lost share
block_use_when.before_after: a change happened and the user needs the value before it and after it
block_use_when.funnel: records drop out stage by stage and the user needs to see where they are lost
block_use_when.network: records are linked to each other and the links explain the case
block_use_when.map_pin: where a record sits matters, by region or place
block_use_when.gauge: one value is judged against a limit and the user needs to see how close it is
block_use_when.timeline: the order of events over time explains the case
block_use_when.cohort_cards: the record belongs to a group and the user needs to see how the group compares

motion_use_when.build: the parts add up to a whole, one after another
motion_use_when.count_up: a single number is the point and its size should land
motion_use_when.morph: one shape turns into another to show a change
motion_use_when.pulse: one part must stand out from the rest
motion_use_when.slide: the user moves along an order or a time line
motion_use_when.fill: a share or a progress amount is filled in
motion_use_when.trace: a line or a path is followed from start to end
motion_use_when.split_merge: one whole divides into parts, or parts join into one
motion_use_when.zoom: the user goes from the whole to one detail
motion_use_when.reveal: the answer or the choice appears once the user has seen the evidence

x-rules.notes: default_actions is the App's record action set (shell_agent.OFFER_ACTIONS, AgentParts.jsx OFFER_BUTTONS); a test keeps it equal. block_optional_roles are columns a block may also read (type-checked when bound, never required); a role in neither list is unknown_role. columns passed to a validator map column name to number, string or date.
